gamerule.minecraft.vo_creative_fly_speed: Multiplier for the player's flying speed while in Creative mode. Default is 1000 (1.0x). Use higher values like 2500 for 2.5x speed. Takes effect instantly for Creative players.
gamerule.minecraft.vo_spectator_fly_spee: Multiplier for flying speed in Spectator mode. Default is 1000 (1.0x). Slow it down for cinematic precision or crank it up to traverse your world at high velocity!
